title: Plural
description: A chat proxy plugin built for plural players. Register your system, set who's fronting, and your messages will show it.
body:
# Plural
**Plural is a message proxying plugin built for plural players on gaming servers!**

It lets players create a system, register their headmates as fronts, and automatically proxy chat messages under whichever front is currently active — displaying their front name and system name alongside each message.

**Installation is simple** — drop it into your server's `plugins` folder, restart, and players can set themselves up straight away with no admin configuration needed.

**From v6+ data syncs over cloud!** — With our online dashbord, you can sync your data from/to your plural app. Visit our online dashboard at [plural.doughmination.win](https://plural.doughmination.win)

> ⚠️ Requires Paper 1.21.1+

*Built for [Doughmination](https://modding.doughmination.win)*
